news.headline: US Fed Hikes 25bp; 10-Year Treasury Rockets to 5.11% — Biggest Single-Day Spike in 18 Months
news.what_happened: The US Federal Reserve raised its benchmark rate 25bp to 3.75-4.00% range (first hike in years). Chair Kevin Warsh signaled further hikes citing persistent inflation. US 10Y yield surged +14.6bp to 5.114% — highest since 2007. S&P 500 -0.76%, Nasdaq -1.13%, Dow -0.69%.
news.why_it_matters: Global risk-off. Rising US yields pressure FII flows into EMs including India. Nasdaq weakness weighs on Indian IT valuations. However India's RBI held rates today at 5.25%, providing a critical domestic cushion. GIFT Nifty -0.59% reflects the overnight anxiety.

news.headline: RBI Holds Repo Rate at 5.25% — MPC Votes Unanimously, Neutral Stance
news.what_happened: The Reserve Bank of India MPC unanimously voted to hold the repo rate at 5.25%. Standing Deposit Facility at 5.00%, MSF at 5.50%. Governor Sanjay Malhotra maintained neutral stance.
news.why_it_matters: Market feared RBI would follow the US Fed and hike, which would have crushed rate-sensitive sectors. The unanimous hold removes this overhang. Positive for loan growth, NIM stability, and EMI affordability. Banks, NBFCs, housing finance and real estate get direct relief.

news.headline: NSE IPO Lists on BSE Today — India's Largest Exchange Makes ₹22,562 Crore Market Debut
news.what_happened: National Stock Exchange of India lists on BSE at ₹1,785 upper price band. IPO subscribed 5.71x. GMP signals 2.4-3.8% listing premium, implying opening price of ₹1,828-₹1,853.
news.why_it_matters: Landmark event. A firm listing on a weak-GIFT-Nifty day would signal strong domestic demand and boost broad market confidence. Watch NSE listing price action for intraday sentiment read. Liquidity may be drawn to this debut.

news.headline: US-Iran UNGA Talks: Iran Vows No Surrender — Crude Remains Volatile, -0.76% Today
news.what_happened: Trump confirmed US-Iran officials met at UNGA. Iran's Pezeshkian vowed Iran will not surrender, snapping crude's 5-day losing streak (Brent +3.9% to $103 Wednesday). Today: WTI -0.76% at $91.46, Brent -0.74% at $97.39 on renewed diplomacy hopes.
news.why_it_matters: US-Iran conflict (8 months) has built $10-15/bbl war premium into crude. Any diplomatic progress = structural crude drop. Today's pullback is modest but sustained easing would massively benefit India's current account, inflation outlook, and consumption sectors (paints, tyres, aviation).

news.headline: India Macro Solid: Direct Tax +13%, Japan Upgrades India to 'A' Rating, BRICS Exports +34%
news.what_happened: India's net direct tax collection rose 13% YoY to $128.94bn through September 17. Japan's credit agency upgraded India's sovereign rating to 'A' category. Exports to BRICS economies grew 34% in April-August 2026-27.
news.why_it_matters: Strong domestic fundamentals provide a floor amid global volatility. Combined DII + FII net buying yesterday (₹2,341 Cr + ₹1,617 Cr) reflects institutional confidence in India's trajectory.
